data.name: Mom Where Are You
data.detailed_description:
Game Content

"Mom, Where Are You?" offers a stimulating and immersive psychological horror experience centered around observation, memory, and survival.

Basic Gameplay

You play as a little girl left alone by her mother, trapped in a familiar yet terrifying room where reality begins to twist.

Every few moments, ordinary objects—lamps, paintings, toys—start to change into evil dolls, driven by a dark spirit that feeds on fear.

Your task is to spot these anomalies and click on them before the timer runs out, or your worst nightmare will appear.

As the seconds tick away, the darkness closes in, and the little girl must confront her deepest fears.

The very dolls she once refused to play with now come to life, trying to scare and control her.

You must help her survive, overcome her fear, and restore the room before it’s too late.

Each level intensifies the tension with faster anomalies, new sounds, and unexpected threats.

Every mistake brings the creature closer... every second matters.

Tension and Consequences

If you miss any anomaly or don't correct it before the timer expires, the lurking creature will approach... until it finally attacks, completely destroys you, and then leaves.

Each level increases the frequency and randomness of the anomaly, testing your attention and tension.

Wrong clicks or hesitation can also lead to danger. Every second counts.

Content and Progression

Multiple levels, each in the same room but with a more challenging environment, increasing the sense of familiarity, heightening the tension, and heightening the fear of mistakes.

Unique object variations: different creature attacks, disturbing substitutions, and spirit-driven transformations.

A progression system in which rounds are repeated, the difficulty increases, and survival depends on intense focus.

Perspirited sound design and eerie ambient cues warn—or mislead—the player.

This demonstrates that game is about observing, clicking on anomalies (my blood is evil), surviving timed rounds, and confronting escalating threats.

Follow Us & Give Feedback❤️

I’d love to hear your feedback and thoughts about the game!
You can share your comments on the Steam page or on our official website — your input helps us improve the experience and make the game even better ❤️

Follow us on our website for more news and updates 
Your encouragement and support mean a lot and help me continue the journey to make the game the best it can be
